packageRules.description: upload-artifact must stay below v4. v4+ bundles @actions/artifact v2, which refuses any non-github.com server outright (GHESNotSupportedError) -- Forgejo implements the v3 artifact API and only that one. A bump across this boundary fails every push-to-main build at the scan-report upload, and it fails invisibly on pull requests because that step is skipped there. Patch updates within v3 are still welcome.
